scope: Fixed-view WebGL2 sprite backend, optional diagnostic car, asset-only WebGPU probe
decision: Canvas remains default; GPU and mesh opt-ins remain experimental
limits: Development Vite source runs, not production-load benchmarks. Desktop full Chromium headless; phone real Chrome/touch.
Desktop comparison sequential. Phone runs sequential, while desktop regression suite ran; host contention may affect initial serving. Not sustained thermal or broad-device evidence.
cold is first 120 sampled frames after game readiness, not HTTP/navigation cold start.
renderMs measures CPU callback time, not GPU execution.
heapBytes is browser-reported live heap, not allocation profiling or total process/GPU memory; phone values are coarse and constant within each run.
GPU textureBytes estimates retained page RGBA storage; excludes source/staging images, model textures, driver/shader memory. targetBytes estimates RGBA plus depth.
uploadedBytes covers requested page texture uploads, vertexUploadedBytes covers batched sprite buffer updates. Neither is measured bus traffic; model uploads are additional.

Probe timings include shader compilation/readback and sequential warm asset reuse; not an API speed comparison. Probe image occupancy differs across backends, so this is renderability, not pixel parity.
Reconstructed car remains unapproved and incomplete.
